mechanics.claim: Thresh and the first allied champion to reach the lantern each receive the shield; an ally can also select the lantern to dash to Thresh and gain the shield.
mechanics.quote: '''Thresh''' and the first allied champion to come near the lantern are granted a {{tip|shield}} for 4 seconds. An ally can select the lantern while in proximity of it, {{tip|dash|dashing}} to '''Thresh''' and gaining the shield.

mechanics.claim: If Thresh moves too far from the lantern it returns to him immediately, and he gains the shield from leashing out of range.
mechanics.quote: If '''Thresh''' moves too far away from the lantern, it returns back to him immediately.

mechanics.claim: An ally cannot pick up the lantern while immobilized, grounded, or silenced.
mechanics.quote: An ally cannot select the lantern while {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}}, {{tip|ground|grounded}}, or {{tip|silence|silenced}}.
